title: AI competitor-intelligence weekly report retainers
one_liner: Productize an agent that monitors a client’s competitors’ ads, prices, launches, and content into a weekly inbox report — setup once, recurring retainer.
why_agent_runnable: Scraping/public monitoring, synthesis, and report formatting are core agent work. Brandon gates client contracts, ToS/compliance, send of reports, and any paid data tools.

ops_steps.title: ICP + niche pick
ops_steps.detail: Score B2B niches where competitors run public ads/pricing/content weekly (ecommerce, local multi-location, SaaS).

ops_steps.title: Brandon niche + compliance box
ops_steps.detail: Approve ICP, allowed data sources, and ToS/legal stance on monitoring.

ops_steps.title: Report template + pipeline
ops_steps.detail: Build draft pipeline: ads library / pricing pages / content RSS → weekly brief template. No live client send yet.

ops_steps.title: Sample report (public comps)
ops_steps.detail: Produce one anonymized sample pack from public data for sales demos.

ops_steps.title: Offer + outreach drafts
ops_steps.detail: Landing/one-pager + outreach sequences; framing $500-2k/mo from source — not a guarantee.

ops_steps.title: Client contract + send gates
ops_steps.detail: Approve first clients, pricing, invoice rail; approve each report send until trust established.

ops_steps.title: Retainer ops loop
ops_steps.detail: Weekly run; log opens/feedback; propose upsell (deeper vertical, more comps) or kill.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.retainer_framing_usd_mo: 500-2000/mo cited in source playbook — framing only
unit_economics_sketch.tool_cost_notes: Scrapers/APIs/ads libraries may add monthly cost; stay ToS-compliant
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: High automation after pipeline; delivery quality and compliance are the risks. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 1: ICP shortlist with public-data richness
Day 5: sample report from public comps
Day 6-7: offer pack + Brandon send gate for first 10 outreaches
kill_criteria: No paying client after 25 Brandon-approved outreaches
Weekly delivery time exceeds what retainer supports after automation pass
Churn >50% in first 90 days or Brandon declines renewals
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
